required_per_base_predictor: fitted imputation and scaling state where applicable
project, modality, candidate, hyperparameters, seed, TRAIN membership and model_identity_sha256 provenance
required_per_multimodal_scope: equivalence-verified base predictors for every participating modality
strict-forward source-only OOF records and fold lineage
fitted LR meta-learner coefficients, intercept and class order
RAW identity or exact persisted isotonic calibration linkage
oof_policy: Every fitted fold-specific predictor and preprocessor used to regenerate OOF meta-features is itself a reconstructed component and must be persisted immediately with fold membership and state digests; the number of fold states is derived only from the frozen project-specific fold lineage.
scope_atomicity: Eligibility is assigned per project/algorithm/configuration identity; shared components must retain every identity linkage that consumes them.
